releases.notes:
# the thanksful update 0.6.0
- the secret music disc's song has been changed to apply with the geneva conventions
- lang files changes
  - cornbread description is now 20% more accurate
  - inscriber no longer encourages piracy
  - corn now has it's own namespace
- nerfed corn bread even further by adding cracked corn
  - cracked corn is made by putting corn in a furnace, replacing the old corn bread recipe
  - corn bread can be crafted like wheat bread, 3 cracked corn in a line
- added pumpkin and cherry pies for the thanksgiving season
- a massive thank you to useless for helping me get this far in my modding endeavors, this mod would not have existed without him

  - thanks to @forsoothe for making corn work better
- a whopping 9 new achievements for you to collect and curse the ground i walk on
- hoods hide player names for all your secretisms
- insurmountable thanks to @UselessBullets for doing the soul-crushing work of this update
